notes: Starter beach logic based on user preferences from the planning thread. Edit rules as you learn more about each beach.

beaches.name: Gas House Beach
beaches.display_note: High tide: paddle boarding, especially if the tide window is a little early or late for Riverhead. Low tide: Brown's Island walk, though Preston is usually the better low-tide walk.

rules.note: Good high-tide paddle option, especially if Riverhead's ideal high-tide window is a little too early or late. Avoid if winds are up.
Fun around low tide when the route is exposed, but usually second choice behind Preston for a pure low-tide walk. Leave margin for the tide turning.

beaches.name: Preston Beach
beaches.display_note: Avoid high tide. Best once tide is out and still dropping, or within about an hour after low.

rules.note: Really pleasant low-tide walk. Strongly prefer this when the tide is out and the weather is decent.

beaches.name: Riverhead Beach
beaches.display_note: Across from Devereux. Excellent paddleboarding near high tide; not great at low tide because the carry gets long.

rules.note: Great high-tide paddleboarding spot across from Devereux. Skip it when the tide is low or the wind is up.

beaches.name: Devereux Beach
beaches.display_note: Good at most tide stages, with bathrooms and showers; low tide adds a short walk, but it is not a paddleboarding pick.

rules.note: Reliable beach stop with facilities; low tide adds beach space, but the walk is short.
Good general beach option when the weather is better than the more tide-specific windows.

beaches.name: Devereux Picnic Shelter
beaches.display_note: Covered fallback for rainy or threatening beach weather.

rules.note: Rainy or threatening weather day: the only sensible beach move is sitting under the Picnic Shelter.
